mapper.insert: insert into pcd_file_info_table(file_id, file_name, file_uploaded_time, file_size, file_type, file_author_id, file_checksum, file_node_id, file_total_chunks, file_storage_path) values(#{id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{uploaded_time}, #{size}, #{type}, #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{checksum}, #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{total_chunks}, #{storage_path});
mapper.select: select * from pcd_file_info_table where file_node_id = #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};
select * from pcd_file_info_table where file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};

select * from pcd_file_info_table where file_node_id = #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_name = #{name} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};

SELECT CASE WHEN f.file_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') LIMIT 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted FROM pcd_file_info_table f WHERE f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND f.file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}

SELECT CASE MIN( CASE WHEN f.file_status = 'DELETED' OR n.node_status = 'DELETED' THEN 1
WHEN f.file_status = 'TRASHED' OR n.node_status = 'TRASHED' THEN 2
ELSE 3 END ) WHEN 1 THEN 'DELETED' WHEN 2 THEN 'TRASHED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS effective_status FROM pcd_file_info_table f LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_closure_table c ON c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table n ON n.node_user_id = c.user_id AND n.node_id = c.ancestor_id AND n.node_status IN ('TRASHED', 'DELETED') WHERE f.file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND f.file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_status
mapper.update: update pcd_file_info_table set file_name = #{file_new_name} where file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};

update pcd_file_info_table set file_node_id = #{target_node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} where file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};

a update pcd_file_info_table set file_status = #{status} where file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};
mapper.delete: delete from pcd_file_info_table where file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} and file_author_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};
